Good morning. This is my last weekly address, and I want to use it to say thank you. Over these years I’ve traveled to every corner of the country, and in each place I met people who reminded me why public service is worth the effort. I met a teacher who spent her own money on supplies, a firefighter who ran toward the danger when everyone else ran away, and a young entrepreneur who started a business in her garage. Their stories, and thousands like them, are the real story of this country. It hasn’t always been easy; we’ve had setbacks, and we’ve had disagreements. But I leave this job more optimistic than when I started. Thank you for your trust, and thank you for letting me serve.
